strings.zh: 一直注视着你,现在是{NEWLINE}精灵训练师学校的时间！

strings.zh: 让我连系起{NEWLINE}各个小镇的每个人,{NEWLINE}这里是街角频道。
strings.en: That town, this town,{NEWLINE}bringing people together.{NEWLINE}The Street Corner Channel.

strings.zh: 最喜欢虫类的男孩子,{NEWLINE}在树丛里也毫不客气地{NEWLINE}冲刺的活泼孩子,{NEWLINE}临机应变地冲上野山{NEWLINE}这样的补充ｚ！
strings.en: This boy loves Bug types! He’s so{NEWLINE}energetic, and he doesn’t mind running{NEWLINE}through thick grass to catch Bug-type{NEWLINE}Pokémon! He does what he wants, on the{NEWLINE}hills and in the fields, this Bug Catcher!

strings.zh: 两人无论何时都在一起,{NEWLINE}生日也在一起,{NEWLINE}吃饭也在一起,{NEWLINE}能分出来吗？{NEWLINE}他们就是这样的双胞胎ｚ！
strings.en: These two are always together.{NEWLINE}They have the same birthday.{NEWLINE}They always eat together.{NEWLINE}Do you think you can tell them apart?{NEWLINE}These Twins!

strings.zh: 兴奋地冲向天空,{NEWLINE}突破大地翱翔天际,{NEWLINE}振翅高飞,{NEWLINE}乘风远行,{NEWLINE}飞往自己想去的地方！{NEWLINE}他就是这样的驯鸟师ｚ！
strings.en: Excitedly dashing for the sky, breaking{NEWLINE}away from the earth to soar, flapping{NEWLINE}up high, riding the wind far away, flying{NEWLINE}wherever he wants to go! That’s the{NEWLINE}Bird Keeper!
strings.notes: US 0420/6 | RV070: meaning: zh: flies where he wants; US I want to fly too

strings.zh: 在客舱内唱歌,{NEWLINE}嗯ｚ,嗯ｚ,嗯ｚ嗯ｚ嗯ｚ{NEWLINE}计划是四天三夜的假期,{NEWLINE}划船、垂钓、登山、散步,{NEWLINE}一路搜寻着伊布。{NEWLINE}他就是这样的旅行者ｚ！
strings.en: Singing in the cabin. Hmm... hmm...{NEWLINE}hmm-hmm-hmm... The plan is a four-day,{NEWLINE}three-night holiday. Rowing, fishing,{NEWLINE}climbing, strolling, and searching for{NEWLINE}Eevee all the way. That’s the Camper!
strings.notes: US 0420/7; modernised from US 0420#7 | RV070: omission: US dropped rowing and walking

strings.zh: 伸出胜利的手势跟人打招呼,{NEWLINE}冷藏箱里塞满了饮料,{NEWLINE}哼着小调在山间行走,{NEWLINE}清晰可见的水平线。{NEWLINE}不好！忘了拿盒饭了！{NEWLINE}她就是热爱大自然的{NEWLINE}郊游少女ｚ！
strings.en: Greeting you with a peace sign, a cooler{NEWLINE}stuffed with drinks, humming a tune{NEWLINE}while hiking in the mountains, the{NEWLINE}horizon clear in view. Oh no! Forgot the{NEWLINE}lunchbox! That’s the{NEWLINE}nature-loving Picnicker!
strings.notes: US 0420/8 | RV070: addition: US added protecting nature rule; horizon detail changed (D-1820)

strings.zh: 被海水呛得流鼻涕,{NEWLINE}在岩石的附近游唦,{NEWLINE}娴熟的蛙唦,{NEWLINE}一直游个不停,结果脚抽筋了,{NEWLINE}被大浪冲刷后的健壮身体,{NEWLINE}今天真倒霉,居然下雨。{NEWLINE}他就是这样的唦裤男ｚ！
strings.en: A runny nose from swallowing seawater,{NEWLINE}swimming near the rocks, a skillful{NEWLINE}breaststroke, swimming nonstop until{NEWLINE}his leg cramps, a sturdy body pounded{NEWLINE}by big waves. What bad luck today: it’s{NEWLINE}raining! That’s the Swimmer!
strings.notes: US 0420/9 | RV070: meaning: zh: skillful breaststroke, sturdy body; US lungs (D-1820)

strings.zh: 拥有如维纳斯般的曲线,{NEWLINE}以及美丽的脸庞。{NEWLINE}昵称叫做美人鱼,{NEWLINE}她每天都在水中度过,{NEWLINE}肚子饿了也当做是减肥,{NEWLINE}有着大量的狂热追随者,{NEWLINE}酒窝中还残留着水滴,{NEWLINE}散着步也会想去游唦。{NEWLINE}她就是这样的比基尼大姐ｚ！
strings.en: Curves like Venus and a beautiful face.{NEWLINE}Nicknamed “Mermaid,” she spends every{NEWLINE}day in the water, and when she’s{NEWLINE}hungry, she calls it a diet. Tons of{NEWLINE}devoted fans, drops of water still in{NEWLINE}her dimples, wanting to swim even while{NEWLINE}out on a walk. That’s the Swimmer!
strings.notes: US 0420/10 | RV070: meaning: zh: every day in water, hunger as diet, wants to swim on walks; US early afternoon

strings.zh: 在冰冷的水面上垂竿钓鱼,{NEWLINE}他的理想是能钓上一条大家伙,{NEWLINE}看到浮子沉了下去,他一收线,{NEWLINE}发现是只破鞋子！{NEWLINE}他就是这样的钓鱼者ｚ！
strings.en: Casting a line into icy water, dreaming{NEWLINE}of landing a big one. The float sinks, he{NEWLINE}reels it in, and it’s a worn-out shoe!{NEWLINE}That’s the Fisherman!
strings.notes: US 0420/11 | RV070: meaning: zh: worn-out shoe; US lively rubber boots

strings.zh: 天黑了,但周围还是那么明亮,{NEWLINE}让人觉得非常不可思议。{NEWLINE}他能燃烧熊熊烈焰,{NEWLINE}感觉能让人烧起来的热血青年。{NEWLINE}不需要蜡烛的人间喷火泵,{NEWLINE}一不小心就容易酿成火灾。{NEWLINE}他就是这样的喷火男ｚ！
strings.en: Night has fallen, but it’s still bright{NEWLINE}around him. How strange. He burns with{NEWLINE}roaring flames, a hot-blooded youth who{NEWLINE}looks like he could set you alight. A{NEWLINE}human fire pump who needs no candle,{NEWLINE}and one slip could start a fire. That’s{NEWLINE}the Firebreather!
strings.notes: US 0420/12 | RV070: meaning: zh: bright around him, hot-blooded youth, could cause fires; US muddled

strings.zh: 这只精灵好帅啊,{NEWLINE}它尾巴的形状很特别啊,{NEWLINE}能不能和我的珍品交换呢？{NEWLINE}想不想看看我的收藏么？{NEWLINE}那个标志不一样。{NEWLINE}抓到了个冒牌货⋯⋯{NEWLINE}这个就是艺术！{NEWLINE}它就是这样的精灵狂热者ｚ！
strings.en: This Pokémon is so cool! The shape of{NEWLINE}its tail is so special! Will you trade it{NEWLINE}for one of my rare pieces? Want to see{NEWLINE}my collection? That mark is different. I{NEWLINE}got a fake... This is art! That’s the{NEWLINE}Poké Maniac!
strings.notes: US 0420/13 | RV070: meaning: zh: trade for my rare piece, mark is different; US figurines (D-1820)

strings.zh: 空手劈开１０块砖！{NEWLINE}他和暴徒不同,{NEWLINE}手上满是水泡,{NEWLINE}但他不会忘记行礼。{NEWLINE}运气的时候会喊“我打！”{NEWLINE}他就是这样的空手道达人ｚ！
strings.en: Splits ten bricks with his bare hand!{NEWLINE}Unlike a thug, his hands are covered in{NEWLINE}blisters, but he never forgets to bow.{NEWLINE}He shouts “Hiyah!” as he focuses his{NEWLINE}power. That’s the Black Belt!
strings.notes: US 0420/14 | RV070: meaning: zh: third person, unlike a thug; US first person, people think I am a hooligan (D-1820)

strings.zh: 可以紧抱,可以蹭脸,{NEWLINE}想永远在一起生活,{NEWLINE}被美丽的精灵所环绕,{NEWLINE}嘴里轻声嘟囔着你的名字,{NEWLINE}它们的热情会让你感到眼晕。{NEWLINE}深爱着可爱的精灵的{NEWLINE}超喜欢俱乐部ｚ！
strings.en: Hold it close, cheek to cheek. I always{NEWLINE}want to be with you, surrounded by{NEWLINE}wonderful Pokémon. I’ll mutter your{NEWLINE}name. So happy, I’m dizzy.{NEWLINE}I love Pokémon! That’s a Pokéfan!

strings.zh: 在船上是暴徒,{NEWLINE}乘风破浪,{NEWLINE}疯狂欢闹,{NEWLINE}到了陆地就乖了。{NEWLINE}他就是这样的船员ｚ！
strings.en: A thug on a boat, plunging on{NEWLINE}through the waves. Dancing and singing{NEWLINE}and having a merry old time. But gentle{NEWLINE}as kittens once they get back on land.{NEWLINE}That’s a Sailor!
strings.notes: US 0420/16 | tone review: 在船上是暴徒 = a thug on the boat, contrasted with tame on land; kept (D-0627)

strings.zh: 在没有取得高分之前,{NEWLINE}他都会不厌其烦地背书,{NEWLINE}做很多的笔记。{NEWLINE}由于接受了很高端的教育,{NEWLINE}所以是名出色的精灵训练师。{NEWLINE}他就是这样的小学生ｚ！
strings.en: Until he gets top marks, he never tires{NEWLINE}of memorizing his books and taking tons{NEWLINE}of notes. Thanks to his top-notch{NEWLINE}education, he’s an excellent Pokémon{NEWLINE}Trainer. That’s the School Kid!
strings.notes: US 0420/17 | RV070: meaning: zh: studies until top marks, elite education; US success, reckless (D-1820)

strings.zh: 小屁孩！给我滚远点！{NEWLINE}要是再让我看到,小心我揍你{NEWLINE}他一骑绝尘,{NEWLINE}和同伙在街上发出噪音,{NEWLINE}人们不得不塞住自己的耳朵,{NEWLINE}当他被打败了才会停车！{NEWLINE}他就是这样的暴走族ｚ！
strings.en: You little brat! Get lost! If I see you{NEWLINE}again, I’ll beat you up! He leaves{NEWLINE}everyone in the dust, making such a{NEWLINE}racket in the streets with his gang{NEWLINE}that people have to plug their ears,{NEWLINE}and he only stops when he’s beaten!{NEWLINE}That’s a Biker!
strings.notes: US 0420/18 | tone review: 小心我揍你 is a threat to beat someone up; kept at full strength (D-0627) | RV070: voice: 小屁孩: you little brat

strings.zh: 啊呜！啊呜！啊呜呜！{NEWLINE}满脸胡渣子的大叔,{NEWLINE}无视旁人,大声呐喊,{NEWLINE}听到远处山上传来啊呜呜{NEWLINE}的回音时非常兴奋。{NEWLINE}他就是这样的登山男ｚ！
strings.en: Yaho... Yaho... Yahohoho...{NEWLINE}Singing in a loud voice without worrying{NEWLINE}about what’s around. A bearded man{NEWLINE}shouts out to the sky. From the far{NEWLINE}mountain. Yahohoho... So happy that the{NEWLINE}echo came back to the Hiker!
